prompt:
You are proposing compression recipes for a factored 1-bit weight-delta format. A recipe assigns an integer rank to each of 8 layer types of the Qwen2.5-1.5B model. The rank for a layer type applies to that matrix in every transformer block, so the recipe's true stored size is the sum over all 197 real matrices, priced per matrix as:

  bytes(matrix, r) = ceil(rows * r / 8) + 4 * rows + 2 * cols * r   (the 4 * rows term is paid even at r = 0)

Real shapes (rows x cols), how many matrices of each type exist, and the exact total cost of each type at rank r (all rows here are divisible by 8, so these linear forms are exact):
  embed: 151936 x 1536, x1 (total cost at rank r: 607,744 + 22,064*r)
  attn.q_proj: 1536 x 1536, x28 (total cost at rank r: 172,032 + 91,392*r)
  attn.k_proj: 256 x 1536, x28 (total cost at rank r: 28,672 + 86,912*r)
  attn.v_proj: 256 x 1536, x28 (total cost at rank r: 28,672 + 86,912*r)
  attn.o_proj: 1536 x 1536, x28 (total cost at rank r: 172,032 + 91,392*r)
  mlp.gate: 8960 x 1536, x28 (total cost at rank r: 1,003,520 + 117,376*r)
  mlp.up: 8960 x 1536, x28 (total cost at rank r: 1,003,520 + 117,376*r)
  mlp.down: 1536 x 8960, x28 (total cost at rank r: 172,032 + 507,136*r)

The total size of a recipe is the sum of those per-type costs and must be <= 39,046,144 bytes (that is the cost of the uniform rank-32 recipe on the same real shapes; you have the same bytes, spend them differently).

Propose exactly 5 recipes. Make them genuinely different from each other and from the uniform recipe: uneven allocations are the point. Ideas you may use or ignore: starve some layers to rank 0 and feed others, front-load early layers, front-load the MLP, protect attention output, protect the embedding (this model ties its embeddings, so the embedding matrix is also the LM head). Every recipe must include every layer name exactly once in its "ranks" object, with an integer rank (0 is allowed and means the layer type's delta is dropped). Ranks may not exceed the smaller dimension of the matrix (256 for attn.k_proj and attn.v_proj, 1536 for the rest).

Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary, in exactly this shape:
{"recipes": [{"name": "<short name>", "reason": "<one sentence>", "ranks": {"embed": 0, "attn.q_proj": 0, "attn.k_proj": 0, "attn.v_proj": 0, "attn.o_proj": 0, "mlp.gate": 0, "mlp.up": 0, "mlp.down": 0}}]}
Replace the zeros with your ranks. Check your arithmetic with the per-type costs above: each recipe's total must be <= 39,046,144 bytes.
